z-m-33-01.title: Uma kunikezwe amaphoyinti amathathu, ingabe iphoyinti elisele limbe kuphela?
z-m-33-01.topic: Ukuthola isiqongo esisele se-parallelogram uma kunikezwe iziqongo ezintathu
z-m-33-01.goal: Hlulela ukuthi isiqongo esisele se-parallelogram simiswe sibe iphoyinti elilodwa yini uma kwaziwa iziqongo ezintathu kuphela, sho ukuthi kungani singamiswa nokuthi yiluphi ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo (ukulandelana kwamagama eziqongo), bese uthola wena amaphoyinti angenzeka.
z-m-33-01.material: Endizeni yamakhodineti kunamaphoyinti amathathu A(0, 0), B(4, 1), C(5, 4). Indlela yokufunda: A ngu-'zero, zero', B ngu-'four, one', C ngu-'five, four'. Lawa maphoyinti amathathu awekho emugqeni owodwa. Ufuna ukukhetha iphoyinti D ukuze amaphoyinti amane A, B, C, D abe yiziqongo ze-parallelogram eyodwa. Inkinga yokuqala isho kuphela 'ake isiqongo sesine sibe ngu-D', futhi ayisho ukuthi iziqongo zixhunywa ngokulandelana okuyini. Onke amakhodineti angamanani angempela, futhi amaphoyinti amane ahlukile komunye nomunye.
z-m-33-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlukanisa amacala angenzeka nokuwathola ngaphandle kokushiya
z-m-33-01.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukuthi ulwazi olwengeziwe lunciphisa kanjani inani lamacala
z-m-33-01.prereq.0: Ukumaka amaphoyinti endizeni yamakhodineti nokufunda isiqondiso nenani lokunyakaza phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili
z-m-33-01.prereq.1: Izici ze-parallelogram (izinhlangothi eziphambene ziyahambisana futhi zilingana ngobude, amadayagonali ayahlukana ngesigamu) - izinga lesikole esiphakathi
z-m-33-01.prereq.2: (Lona umsebenzi obekwe ku-H2 ukuze kube lula ukukhiqiza; ukhombisa izinga lobunzima, hhayi ibanga. Kucatshangwa ukuthi kufundiswa ngemva kwe-'plane coordinates' ku-Common Mathematics.)
z-m-33-01.s.s1.prompt: Ingabe indawo yephoyinti D imiswe yilolu lwazi olungenhla? Khetha isinqumo esifaneleka kakhulu.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.hint.0: Maka u-A, B, no-C endizeni yamakhodineti bese wengeza elinye iphoyinti kulawa amathathu ukwenza i-parallelogram.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.hint.1: Shintsha ukuthi yiliphi kwamaphoyinti amathathu eliphambene no-D, maka u-D isikhathi ngasinye, bese uhlola ngamehlo isikhathi ngasinye ukuthi izinhlangothi eziphambene ziyahambisana yini.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.a: Kumisiwe libe linye. Amaphoyinti amathathu amisiwe, ngakho iphoyinti lokugcina nalo linye kuphela
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi uma amaphoyinti amathathu emisiwe, okusele kumisiwe kube kunye. Khumbula ukuthi igama lomumo onezinhlangothi ezine (ABCD) linokulandelana okwakhelwe kulo.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.b: Akumisiwe. Izinhlangothi zidinga kuphela ukuhambisana, ngakho kunezingenasiphelo
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.b: Kubonakala sengathi ufunde umbandela wokuhambisana njengebhangqa elilodwa kuphela. I-parallelogram inamabhangqa womabili ezinhlangothi ezihambisanayo, futhi imibandela emibili eyengeziwe imisa iphoyinti. Maka amaphoyinti wena ukuhlola.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.c: Akumisiwe. Kuncike ekutheni yiliphi iphoyinti elenziwe liphambene nelipi
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.c: Ukhombe ukuthi u-D uyashintsha uma ibhangqa eliphambene lishintsha. Uma ubala nokuthi mangaki amabhangqa angenzeka, uzobona inombolo.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.d: Ubone ukuthi kunama-D amaningana, kodwa kubonakala sengathi ubale amanye kuphela. Hamba ngawo wonke amaphoyinti angaphambene no-D, linye ngesikhathi.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.explain: Kuncike ekutheni yiliphi kwamaphoyinti amathathu A, B, C eliphambene no-D, i-parallelogram iyashintsha, ngakho kunezindawo ezintathu ezingenzeka zika-D. Uma unikezwa ulwazi lokuthi amagama eziqongo axhunywa ngokulandelana (isibonelo, umumo onezinhlangothi ezine u-ABCD), amabhangqa aphambene amisiwe futhi u-D unciphela kube munye. Ngakho ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo kule nkinga ukulandelana kweziqongo.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.prompt: Thola bese ufaka amaphoyinti angu-3 ahlukile D(x, y) afeza umbandela. Kwanele ukuthi amaphoyinti amane abe yiziqongo ze-parallelogram eyodwa ngokulandelana okuthile. Ebhokisini elingezansi, qala ubhale kuphela amakhodineti amaphoyinti, bese ubhala izizathu.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha elilodwa kwamaphoyinti amathathu futhi uliqambe ngo-'eliphambene no-D', bese ubona ukuthi u-D uhlobene kanjani nesigaba esixhuma amanye amaphoyinti amabili.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.hint.1: Shintsha iphoyinti olikhethayo njengelaphambene ngokulandelana u-A, B, C, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ama-D atholakalayo ahlukile komunye nomunye yini.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Le yindawo lapho u-A, B, C, D besiba yiziqongo ze-parallelogram eyodwa.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ngale phoyinti D, ukuxhuma u-A, B, C, D ngokulandelana okuthile akwenzi i-parallelogram. Hlola ukuthi amaphoyinti aphakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili aphambene afana yini.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.explain: Ama-D angenzeka ngamaphoyinti amathathu (9, 5), (1, 3), (-1, -3). Ayizimo lapho u-D ephambene no-A, B, no-C ngokulandelana, futhi ecaleni ngalinye amaphoyinti aphakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili aphambene asendaweni efanayo.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala ukuthi kungani u-D engamiswanga abe munye, nalokho ocabanga ngakho ngokuthi kungabakhona yini ama-D angenzeka engeziwe.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Maka ukuthi yiliphi phakathi kuka-A, B, C iphoyinti ngalinye owalimakile eliphambene nalo.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bala ukuthi mangaki amaphoyinti angaphambene no-D.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngichaze ukuthi kungani u-D eshintsha ngo-'iphoyinti eliphambene naye'?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngibhale, ngisho nangomugqa owodwa, isizathu sika-'kungabakhona okwengeziwe' (ubufakazi bokuthi ngihlukanise wonke amacala)?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ngikhethe iphoyinti elilodwa engilimakile futhi ngahlola futhi ukuthi izinhlangothi zalo eziphambene ziyahambisana yini?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.model.0: U-D uyashintsha kuncike ekutheni amaphoyinti amabili yimaphi owathatha njengeziqongo eziphambene. Uma ephambene no-A ungu-(9, 5), uma ephambene no-B ungu-(1, 3), futhi uma ephambene no-C ungu-(-1, -3). U-A, B, C kuphela abangaphambene no-D, ngakho u-3 yikho konke okukhona.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Amaphoyinti aphakathi kwamadayagonali kumele afane, ngakho ukukhetha elilodwa kwamaphoyinti amathathu njengaleli eliphambene no-D kunikeza u-D oyedwa ngakunye. Kunezindlela ezi-3 zokukhetha, ngakho u-D unezindawo ezi-3, futhi ngicabanga ukuthi akunakubakhona okwengeziwe.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Noma ungabhalanga amakhodineti, kwanele uma unenombolo nesizathu.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.prompt: Kufike ulwazi olusha. Uma uhlola futhi inkinga, yathi 'parallelogram ABCD', futhi iziqongo zixhunywe ngokulandelana u-A, B, C, D (u-A no-C baphambene, u-B no-D baphambene). U-D usephi manje?
z-m-33-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala phansi ukuthi yiziphi iziqongo eziseduze no-D ku-ABCD.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.hint.1: Khetha iphoyinti bese uhlola wena ukuthi ukunyakaza kusuka ohlangothini AB kuya ohlangothini DC kunesiqondiso esifanayo nosayizi ofanayo yini.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.a: Ufunde ngokuthi u-A no-D baphambene. Ngokulandelana ABCD, amabhangqa aphambene ngu-A no-C, no-B no-D.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.b: Ulibeke ukuze u-B no-D baphambene. Hlola ukuthi izinhlangothi eziphambene AB no-DC zinesiqondiso nobude obufanayo yini.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.c: Ufunde ngokuthi u-C no-D baphambene. Ngokulandelana ABCD, omakhelwane ba-C ngu-B no-D.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.o.d: Kusengakwazi ukwaziwa ukuthi yiyiphi yezindawo ezintathu
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.d: Ushiye ukuthi ukulandelana kumisa amabhangqa aphambene. Uma ukulandelana sekunikeziwe, bhala phansi ukuthi yiliphi iphoyinti eliphambene no-A neliphambene no-B.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.explain: Ngokulandelana ABCD, u-B no-D baphambene, ngakho D = A + C - B, okungukuthi, (0+5-4, 0+4-1) = (1, 3). Hlola: i-vector AB = (4, 1), futhi i-vector DC = (5-1, 4-3) = (4, 1), efanayo. Ulwazi olusha lunciphise kwaba nye kwezindawo ezintathu ezingenzeka.

z-m-33-02.thinking.1: Ukuguqula isahlulelo sakho nokuzethemba lapho kufika ulwazi olusha
z-m-33-02.title: Uma kuvela umugqa, ingabe izindingilizi ezimbili ziyahlangana?
z-m-33-02.topic: Indawo yezindingilizi ezimbili nomugqa ovela ezibalweni zezindingilizi ezimbili
z-m-33-02.goal: Sebenzisa izibonelo ukuhlola ukuthi noma umugqa uhlala uvela ezibalweni zezindingilizi ezimbili, lokho kuphela akusho ukuthi izindingilizi ziyahlangana, bese wakha wena izindingilizi ezimbili ezingahlangani ukuze usho ukuthi yini enye edinga ukuhlolwa.
z-m-33-02.material: Isibalo sendingilizi C1 ngu-x²+y²=4 (isikhungo (0, 0), uradiyasi 2). Indlela yokufunda: 'x squared plus y squared equals 4'. Indingilizi C2 inesikhungo (d, 0) noradiyasi r, ne-d>0, r>0. Isibalo sayo ngu-(x-d)²+y²=r². UHayun wasusa isibalo se-C2 kusibalo se-C1 uhlangothi nohlangothi wathola inkulumo yedigri lokuqala ku-x, futhi wathi, 'Kuvele umugqa, ngakho izindingilizi ezimbili ziyahlangana emaphoyinteni amabili lapho lo mugqa udlula khona.' Lapha, izindingilizi ezimbili 'ziyahlangana' kusho ukuthi kukhona iphoyinti elilala kuzo zombili izindingilizi (kufaka icala lapho zithintana).
z-m-33-02.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa imibandela lapho isitatimende sisebenza khona nezibonelo lapho singasebenzi khona
z-m-33-02.thinking.2: Ukwakha wena izibonelo eziphikisayo nokuzihlunga zibe izinhlobo
z-m-33-02.prereq.0: Incazelo yesibalo sendingilizi (x-a)²+(y-b)²=r² nokufunda isikhungo noradiyasi
z-m-33-02.prereq.1: Incazelo yezindawo zezindingilizi ezimbili (ezihlukene, ezithintanayo, ezihlangana emaphoyinteni amabili, eyodwa iqukethe enye)
z-m-33-02.prereq.2: (Lona umsebenzi obekwe ku-H2 ukuze kube lula ukukhiqiza; ukhombisa izinga lobunzima, hhayi ibanga. Kucatshangwa ukuthi uza ngemva kokufunda isibalo sendingilizi ku-Common Mathematics.)
z-m-33-02.s.s1.prompt: Idatha izembulwa linye ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, hlulela ukuthi izindingilizi ezimbili ziyahlangana emaphoyinteni amangaki, bese ucabanga ukuthi ungasethemba kangakanani isitatimende sikaHayun.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.hint.0: Faka ngqo amakhodineti ephoyinti elisemugqeni esibalweni se-C1 ukuhlola ukuthi ngempela lifeza nalo yini.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.hint.1: Uma d no-r kushintsha, qhathanisa ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo ezimbili nesamba samaradiyasi.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Ukususa izibalo ze-C1 ne-C2 kunikeza 2dx = d² + 4 - r², ngakho inqobo nje uma d ingeyona u-0, uthola umugqa lapho x inani elilodwa. Amanani e-d ne-r awakaziwa.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ungasho ukuthi 'izindingilizi ezimbili ziyahlangana' ngeqiniso lokuthi kuvele umugqa kuphela?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Umugqa ovelayo ulwazi lokuthi 'uma kukhona amaphoyinti okuhlangana, alala kulo mugqa'. Isiqinisekiso sokuthi kukhona amaphoyinti okuhlangana kumele sihlolwe ngokwehlukana. Ake siwuhlole ngedatha elandelayo.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ungasho kanjalo. Wonke amaphoyinti ahlanganyelwe ezindingilizini ezimbili alala kulo mugqa
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kubonakala sengathi ufunde 'uma kukhona iphoyinti elihlanganyelwe, lilala emugqeni' njengo-'kukhona iphoyinti elihlanganyelwe'. Isitatimende sokuqala sikhuluma ngokuthi iphoyinti likhona nini.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Awukwazi ukusho kanjalo. Konke ongakwazi ukuthi uma kukhona amaphoyinti okuhlangana, alala kulo mugqa
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uhlukanise lokho umugqa ukutshela kona nalokho ongakutsheli.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Awukwazi ukusho kanjalo. Umugqa ovelayo empeleni usho ukuthi izindingilizi ezimbili aziyihlangani
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ufunde iqiniso lokuthi kuvele umugqa njengobufakazi ohlangothini oluphambene. Cabanga ukuthi umugqa uvela nakuzindingilizi ezimbili ezihlangene yini.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Uma ungawazi amanani e-d ne-r, lo mugqa awutsheli lutho
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ngaphandle kwamanani awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi kukhona amaphoyinti okuhlangana yini, kodwa ungasho ukuthi azoba kuphi uma ekhona. Hlola ukuthi ngempela lo mugqa awunikezi lwazi yini.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Kumisiwe ukuthi d = 6, r = 1. Ukususa izibalo kunikeza 12x = 39, okungukuthi, umugqa x = 13/4 = 3.25. Ukuze iphoyinti elisemugqeni lilale nakuC1, udinga y² = 4 - (13/4)² = -105/16 (y iyinombolo yangempela).
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.after: y² ayinasimo, ngakho akukho phoyinti le-C1 kulo mugqa. Lokhu kuhambisana nokuthi ibanga 6 phakathi kwezikhungo likhulu kunesamba samaradiyasi, 3, ngakho izindingilizi zihlukene. Kuvele umugqa, kodwa izindingilizi ezimbili aziyihlangani. Iqiniso lokuthi umugqa uhlala uvela akulona ubufakazi bamaphoyinti okuhlangana.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Amaphoyinti angu-2. Njengoba uHayun ethe, kuvele umugqa, ngakho ziyahlangana emaphoyinteni amabili
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uqhubeka nokwamukela umugqa ovelayo njengobufakazi bamaphoyinti okuhlangana. Bheka ukuthi ngempela kukhona iphoyinti le-C1 kulo mugqa yini.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Iphoyinti e-1. Umugqa ne-C1 bahlangana endaweni eyodwa
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ucabange ngecala lapho umugqa nendingilizi bahlangana, kodwa kubonakala sengathi awuhlolanga uphawu luka-y². Uma y² ingenamsoco, ingabe kukhona y yangempela?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Amaphoyinti angu-0. Akukho phoyinti le-C1 emugqeni
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uhlulele ngokususelwa emphumeleni wokufanisa amaphoyinti asemugqeni nesibalo se-C1.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Ushintshele ku-d = 3, r = 2. Ukususa izibalo kunikeza 6x = 9, okungukuthi, umugqa x = 3/2. Ukuwufaka ku-C1 kunikeza y² = 4 - 9/4 = 7/4.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kulokhu, izindingilizi ezimbili ziyahlangana emaphoyinteni amangaki?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.after: y = ±√7/2 (cishe ±1.32), ngakho ziyahlangana emaphoyinteni amabili (3/2, ±√7/2). Kuyasebenza nasohlangothini lwe-C2: (3/2 - 3)² + 7/4 = 4. Kulokhu isiphetho sikaHayun besilungile. Okunquma ukuthi ziyahlangana yini akulona iqiniso lokuthi kuvele umugqa, kodwa ukuthi kukhona amaphoyinti e-C1 kulowo mugqa yini.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Amaphoyinti angu-2. y ithatha amanani amabili, elihle nelingenamsoco, ngakho kunamaphoyinti amabili
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ufunde ukuthi y ithatha amanani amabili kusuka ku-y² = 7/4.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Amaphoyinti angu-0. Noma kuvele umugqa, njengakuqala, azihlangani
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Usebenzise isibonelo sangaphambili kulesi njengoba sinjalo. Qhathanisa ukuthi uphawu luka-y² kulokhu lufana nolwangaphambili yini.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Iphoyinti e-1. Kunephoyinti elilodwa kuphela le-C1 emugqeni
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Iphoyinti e-1. Kunephoyinti elilodwa kuphela le-C1 emugqeni
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Bala ukuthi mangaki ama-y avela enanini elilodwa le-y². Uma y² inhle, bangaki ama-y?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.info: Ushintshele ku-d = 4, r = 2. Ukususa izibalo kunikeza 8x = 16, okungukuthi, umugqa x = 2. Ukuwufaka ku-C1 kunikeza y² = 4 - 4 = 0.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.after: Kunge-y = 0 kuphela, ngakho zithintana endaweni eyodwa (2, 0). Leli yicala lapho ibanga 4 phakathi kwezikhungo lilingana nesamba samaradiyasi 2+2. Kulokhu umugqa x = 2 uyisithinteli esihlanganyelwe sezindingilizi ezimbili. Noma kuvele umugqa, inani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana lingaba ngu-0, 1, noma 2.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Amaphoyinti angu-0. Kuvele umugqa, kodwa awuhlangani ne-C1
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Kungenzeka ufunde y² = 0 njenge-'akukho sixazululo'. Hlola ukuthi ikhona y yangempela efeza y² = 0.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Ubone ukuthi uma y² = 0, kunge-y eyodwa kuphela.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Amaphoyinti angu-2. Njengesinyathelo sangaphambilini, umugqa udlula emaphoyinteni amabili
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Udlulisele umphumela wesinyathelo sangaphambilini njengoba unjalo. Qhathanisa ukuthi mangaki ama-y avela enanini le-y² kulokhu nokuthi mangaki avela ngaphambili.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.reflect: Ukholwa kwakho ngeqiniso lokuthi kuvele umugqa kwashintsha kanjani njengoba udlula ezibonelweni? Kwakuhluke kanjani phakathi kwamacala lapho isitatimende sikaHayun sasilungile nalawo lapho singalungile? Yini okumele uyihlole njalo ngemva kokuthi kuvele umugqa?
z-m-33-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza wena izibonelo lapho isitatimende sikaHayun singalungile. Khetha isikhungo (d, 0) noradiyasi r ye-C2 bese ufaka izinhlobo ezi-2 ezahlukile zamacala lapho izindingilizi ezimbili zingahlangani. Isibonelo esisodwa sibe lapho izindingilizi ezimbili zihlukene ngaphandle komunye nomunye, nesinye lapho indingilizi eyodwa iqukethe enye ukuze zingahlangani.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qhathanisa uradiyasi 2 we-C1 no-r bese ucabanga ukuthi ibanga d phakathi kwezikhungo kumele libe likhulu kangakanani ukuze zihlukane.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ukubeka indingilizi eyodwa ngaphakathi kwenye, zama ukuthi ukhetha kanjani u-d ngokuqhathanisa nomehluko wamaradiyasi.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.hint.2: Ngemva kokukhetha abangenela, baqhathanise nesibonelo osibone ngaphambili, njengo-d = 6, r = 1, bese uhlola ukuthi bayohlobo olufanayo.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Kokubili u-d no-r kumele babe bakhulu kuno-0.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Lezi zindingilizi ezimbili ziyahlangana noma ziyathintana. Kumele kube yisibonelo lapho zingahlangani. Qhathanisa ibanga phakathi kwezinkungu nama-radius.
z-m-33-02.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo: (d, r) = (5, 1) linebanga phakathi kwezinkungu elingu-5, elikhulu kunesamba sama-radius esingu-3, ngakho zihlukene ngaphandle, futhi (1, 5) i-C2 iqukethe i-C1, ngakho azihlangani (iradiyasi ye-C1 ingu-2, nebanga lenkungu elingu-1 lincane kunomehluko wama-radius amabili okungu-3). Kuwo womabili amacala d > 0, ngakho kuvela umugqa, kodwa izindingilizi ezimbili azihlangani. Icala lokuthinta kusukela ngaphakathi (isibonelo, d = 2, r = 4) lihlangana kuphoyinti elilodwa, ngakho alibalwa.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.prompt: Tshela uHayun: uma ukhipha ama-equation futhi kuvela umugqa, yini enye okufanele ihlolwe ngaphambi kokuthi usho ukuthi 'izindingilizi ezimbili ziyahlangana', futhi kungani? Kubhale.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale emugqeni owodwa ukuthi kungani, esibonelweni u-d = 6, r = 1, zazingahlangani noma kwavela umugqa.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.hint.1: Khumbula ukuthi ngokubala noma ngokuqhathanisa kuphi okwakwenze wafunda esibonelweni ukuthi azihlangani.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngihlukanise, ngamazwi ami, ukuthi iqiniso lokuthi kuvele umugqa neqiniso lokuthi izindingilizi ezimbili ziyahlangana akufani?
z-m-33-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uma ngisebenzisa indlela yokuhlola engiyibhalile esibonelweni u-d = 6, r = 1, inika isiphetho sokuthi azihlangani?
z-m-33-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ngishilo ukuthi amaphoyinti umugqa odlula kuwo aphezu kwezindingilizi zombili nini?
z-m-33-02.s.s3.model.0: Noma kuvela umugqa, kumele uhlole ngokwehlukana ukuthi kukhona yini iphoyinti elivamile lezindingilizi ezimbili kulowo mugqa. Faka umugqa ku-equation yesindingilizi esisodwa futhi ubone ukuthi kuphuma yini iphoyinti lokuhlangana langempela, futhi uma kungenjalo, izindingilizi ezimbili azihlangani.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.model.1: Ungaqhathanisa nebanga phakathi kwezinkungu nesamba noma umehluko wama-radius. Umugqa uhlala uvela ngaphandle uma u-d engu-0, ngakho ukuba nomugqa kuphela akuqinisekisi amaphoyinti okuhlangana, futhi kumele uhlole ukuthi kukhona ngempela yini amaphoyinti okuhlangana.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kokubili indlela yokufaka emugqeni nendlela yokuqhathanisa amabanga iyamukelwa.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.model.2: Kumele uqhathanise ibanga u-d phakathi kwezinkungu zezindingilizi ezimbili nesamba sama-radius esingu-2+r nomehluko u-|2-r|. Uma likhulu kunesamba noma lincane kunomehluko, izindingilizi ezimbili azihlangani noma kuvela umugqa.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.modelNote.2: Impendulo esebenzisa ukuqhathanisa ibanga iyamukelwa nayo.
